title: Short Cuts
events_chronological: Helicopters spray Los Angeles for medflies through the night, passing over every neighbourhood in the film.
Doctor Ralph Wyman and his wife Marian, a painter, get ready for a dinner party.
Baker Andy Bitkower takes an order for a birthday cake for a boy called Casey Finnigan.
Casey is knocked down by a car driven by waitress Doreen Piggot on his way to school and walks home insisting he is fine.
Casey collapses into a coma, and his parents Howard and Ann keep vigil at the hospital.
Howard's estranged father Paul turns up at the hospital and confesses an affair from decades ago.
Unpaid and ignored, the baker starts making anonymous menacing phone calls to the Finnigans.
Telephone-sex worker Lois Kaiser talks men through their fantasies from her living room while her husband Jerry seethes beside her.
Jerry and three friends drive out to fish and find a young woman's body face down in the river.
The men leave the body tied to the bank and fish for two more days before reporting it.
Stuart's wife Claire, a party clown, is disgusted when she learns what the men did.
Jazz singer Tess Trainer performs nightly in a club while her cellist daughter Zoe plays alone at home.
Police officer Gene Shepard, cheating on his wife Sherri with Betty Weathers, abandons the family dog to cover one of his lies.
Betty's ex-husband Stormy Weathers, a helicopter pilot, learns she has a new man and saws her furniture to pieces.
Bill and Honey Bush house-sit for the Wymans and photograph Honey made up as a beaten corpse.
At the dinner party Marian admits to a long-ago nude modelling session and an affair, and Ralph makes a scene.
Casey dies in hospital, and Howard and Ann go to the bakery to confront Andy, who feeds them warm bread and grieves with them.
Zoe finds her mother asleep, closes the garage door and kills herself with the car engine running.
At a picnic in the hills Jerry Kaiser smashes a young woman's head with a rock.
An earthquake shakes the whole city, and the deaths and the damage are folded together into the evening news.
syuzhet_notes: The film braids nine loosely connected Los Angeles stories that run at the same time rather than one after another, cutting between them constantly and often on a sound or a passing car. Because the strands are concurrent, most of the reordering is lateral - the film moves sideways between households rather than backwards in time - with the medfly spraying at told-order bullet 1 and the earthquake at bullet 20 bracketing everything in between.
fabula_notes: The strands are simultaneous and the film supplies almost no clock times, so the ordering across the three days rests on the few hard markers: the cake is ordered before the accident, the fishing trip runs across a weekend, the earthquake closes everything. The dead woman in the river is never identified or explained, and any connection between her and Jerry Kaiser's final act is left for the audience to draw.
